justification: On a proxy 2D Kolmogorov turbulence SR task, adversarially trained UNet (adv-NO analog) reduced spectral error relative to an L2-only baseline by 2.6x and recovered far more high-wavenumber energy (e.g., 79% vs 4% at k=30), confirming spectral-bias mitigation (C1) and sharper small-scale structure (C3). This improvement came with higher field NRMSE (+30%), matching the reported trade-off direction (C2). However, the magnitude of spectral-error reduction was substantially smaller than the paper’s ~15x on Schlieren, likely due to different data, smaller model, and simpler losses/training. The exact numerical values in Table 1 were not reproduced on the proprietary dataset. Claims on 3D HIT forecasting and sparse PTV reconstruction (C4) were not attempted.
